ns2:section.sectionText: Second eight weeks course. This section for outside majors only. Students registered in this section will be charged a $20 course materials fee. Registration is open only graduate students or seniors with a 3.0 GPA or others with permission of the instructor. Course pre-requisites include organic or food chemistry and microbiology. All students registering for the course must be at least 21 years old.
ns2:section.sectionDeptRestriction: Not intended for students in the Food Science & Human Nutrition department.
